pages.title: Agent Sessions and Project Workflows
pages.purpose: Explain how the Agent Host creates, manages, and persists Pi agent sessions, builds context pages, auto-titles sessions, forks, manages worktrees, session lists/indexing, and file watchers.
instructions: Explain session lifecycle, the in-process AgentSessionWrapper, queueing/steer/follow-up, session file persistence under ~/.pi/agent/sessions, session path cache, indexing/fingerprinting, and allowed-root file access policy.

pages.title: Configuration, Models, and Credentials
pages.purpose: Document model/provider configuration, model catalog refresh, credential storage via the CredentialVault and Pi credential sync, theme/ui state, and channel credential persistence.
instructions: Explain models.json location, atomic writes with conflict detection, model refresh coordinator with timeout/cancel, enabled-model preferences, credential vault encryption via safeStorage, and ui-state persistence.

pages.title: Agent Host Supervision and Resilience
pages.purpose: Document how the Main process supervises the Agent Host utilityProcess: crash detection, restart budget, heartbeats, managed-process pre-restart gate, and Host/Renderer recovery flows.
instructions: Explain restart-on-crash with CRASH_WINDOW_MS/MAX_RESTARTS, ping timeout kill, snapshot acknowledgements (toolchain/browser), the renderer reconnect flow on host restart/crash, and the managed-process containment gate before restart.

pages.title: Architecture Overview
pages.purpose: Explain the Electron three-process architecture: Main process, Agent Host utilityProcess, and sandboxed React Renderer, plus the typed MessagePort RPC contract and persistence surface.
instructions: Explain responsibility boundaries across Main / Agent Host / Renderer, the MessagePort handoff through preload, host supervision/restart, and the no-TCP-surface principle. Describe the data/control flow for a typical session prompt.

pages.title: Persistence and State Surface
pages.purpose: Catalog where Pi Agent Desktop persists state: sessions, models.json, agent config in ~/.pi/agent, credential vault, browser settings/grants/secrets, toolchain state, and managed-process reaper journal.
instructions: Enumerate the key persisted files, their owners, write patterns (atomic temp+rename, mode 0o600), versioning/conflict checks, and what happens on corruption or missing encryption availability.

pages.title: RPC Contract and System API
pages.purpose: Document the typed request/response and event-stream RPC contract that connects Renderer to Agent Host, the five wire message kinds, leases, timeouts, and how main bridges host->main calls.
instructions: Describe Api.method/Streams, the RpcWriter/response/event wire kinds, subscription semantics, leases, call timeouts, and the host->main (callMain) path used for browser, toolchain, and credential operations.

pages.title: Built-in Browser Service
pages.purpose: Document the Main-owned WebContentsView browser: profiles, tabs, agent authorization, policy engine, network interception, downloads, secret vault, and advanced browser mode.
instructions: Explain browser settings/policy versioning, permission model (none/read/interact/advanced), runtime grants + leases, user takeover, network interception and header rules, advanced mode with CDP/cookies/UA, private-network protection, and the unresolved cookies gate.

pages.title: Messaging Channels (Weixin, Telegram, Feishu/Lark)
pages.purpose: Document the messaging-channel subsystem in the Agent Host: adapters, inbound processing, pairing, bindings, per-session workspaces, outbound rendering, and media staging.
instructions: Explain channel account/config/secret persistence, QR login flows, pairing TTL, inbound policy decisions, lane-scheduled sequential processing, bindings to Pi sessions, and per-channel outbound/media specifics.

pages.title: Change Guide: Main Process and IPC
pages.purpose: Focused guide for safely adding or changing Main-process behavior and the Renderer-Host IPC surface, with verification steps.
instructions: Walk through adding a new desktop IPC channel (contract type, preload method, main handler with trusted sender guard), adding an Agent Host Api/Stream, and how to run the contract-coverage and related checks.

pages.title: Updates and Packaging
pages.purpose: Document the update pipeline (electron-updater adapter, update manager state machine, install protocol), platform packaging targets, and update integrity/limitations.
instructions: Explain the update state machine (check/download/install with busy, offset, signature/integrity), automatic check scheduling, install capacity gating on running sessions and managed processes, and platform/artifact packaging.

pages.title: Managed Process Crash Recovery (Reaper)
pages.purpose: Document the Main-process ManagedProcessReaper, journal persistence, identity fingerprinting, POSIX process-group reaping, and the Windows helper/Job Object recovery path.
instructions: Explain reaper readiness, journal v2 records, identity checks via start fingerprint, reap outcomes, fail-closed containment when cleanup cannot be confirmed, Windows helper secure directory and provenance, and quit/update cleanup.

pages.title: Managed Background Processes (Agent Host)
pages.purpose: Document the managed background-process service in the Agent Host: lifecycle, states, readiness, output buffering, policy limits, LAN-bind confirmation, stop modes, and Windows/POSIX backends.
instructions: Explain how process_* agent tools start/manage processes, output buffering and cursors, start rate/active limits, readiness detection, user-stop barriers, POSIX process groups vs Windows Job Object, and command-blocking heuristics.

pages.title: Logging and Diagnostics
pages.purpose: Document the main logger, log rotation/redaction, diagnostics export, crash reporting, and packaged startup validation reports.
instructions: Explain the rotating main.log, sanitization/redaction, diagnostics archive export, crash reporter upload-to-server false, and the packaged-startup/custom validation report files.

pages.title: Testing and Quality Gates
pages.purpose: Document the test runner, verify gate pipeline, contract/security/i18n checks, managed-process workflow tests, Electron smoke tests, and how to run focused tests.
instructions: Explain node:test discovery under src/**/*.test.mjs, the verify pipeline order, and where each check lives. Note that unit tests run in Node without a GPU/display and that Electron integration tests are separate scripts.

pages.title: Developer Toolchains (Discovery and Managed Runtimes)
pages.purpose: Document the toolchain subsystem: capability discovery from system/bundled/managed sources, probing, candidate selection, project resolution, and app-private managed runtime install/repair/remove.
instructions: Explain capability IDs, provider priority, probing/verification, preference modes, per-project resolution caching, managed component lifecycle, and how executions consume resolved command descriptors and environment patches.

pages.title: Quickstart
pages.purpose: Practical guide to setting up a development environment, running the Electron app, building, packaging, and testing Pi Agent Desktop, with pointers to the architecture and operations guides.
instructions: Cover local development setup (Node 22.19+, npm ci, npm run dev), the build pipeline, the full verify gate, packaging for each platform, and how sessions/config live in ~/.pi/agent/.
